# @weight 1

busybox's gzip, gunzip and zcat (archival/gzip.c, bbunzip.c and libarchive's
unpack_gz_stream).  Every expectation is busybox's own output, from a busybox
built from its source, run as an ordinary user, less the banner line its usage
text starts with.  A `|` marks the end of each line written to standard
output; output that is not text is shown as its bytes in hex, 32 to a line;
`after:` is what a command run after shows.  busybox compresses with deflate
code of its own and this with the system zlib: on the short inputs here the
two write the same bytes.

## the fixtures

### the files, which busybox made, and a run of an applet in a fresh directory

`hello` and `three` are text, and `hello.gz`, `three.gz` and `three.tgz`
busybox's gzip of them.  `flags.gz` has a header with an extra field, a
name, a comment and a header CRC, and an mtime of 2020-01-02 03:04:05;
`badcrc.gz` and `badlen.gz` have a trailer changed, `short.gz` and
`header.gz` are cut short, `badblock.gz` holds a block of a type there is
none of, `plain.gz` is text, `empty.gz` is nothing, `two.gz` is two
members, and `trail.gz` a member with bytes after it.  Each run is in
`/tmp/x-cu-gz/w`, made afresh from them: PRE runs before the applet, with
standard input the file IN (`-` for none), and POST after it, both through
the shell.

```cu
(do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "rm -rf /tmp/x-cu-gz && mkdir -p /tmp/x-cu-gz/w")) (def gz-f (fn (_ n) (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-gz/" n))) (file-write-all (gz-f "fx.b64") "") (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "cd /tmp/x-cu-gz && base64 -d < fx.b64 > fx.tar && tar xf fx.tar")) (def gz-home (Sys getcwd)) (def gz-sh (fn (_ cmd out) (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" (string-concat (list "cd /tmp/x-cu-gz/w && { " cmd "; } > " out " 2>&1")))))) (def gz-in (fn (_ name) (if (string=? name "-") "" (let ((fd (file-open-read (string-append "/tmp/x-cu-gz/w/" name))) (buf (%str-make-raw 65536))) (let ((n (File read fd buf 65536))) (do (file-close fd) (pair buf n))))))) (def gz-shown (fn (_ mode) (if (string=? mode "x") (do (proc-run (list "/bin/sh" "-c" "od -An -v -tx1 /tmp/x-cu-gz/o | tr -d ' \\n' | fold -w 64 > /tmp/x-cu-gz/hex; echo >> /tmp/x-cu-gz/hex")) (file-read-all (gz-f "hex"))) (Str8 replace "\n" "|\n" (file-read-all (gz-f "o")))))) (def gz-case (fn (_ fresh in pre post mode argv) (do (if fresh (gz-sh "cd /tmp/x-cu-gz && rm -rf w && mkdir w && cp -p fx/* w/" "/dev/null") ()) (if (string=? pre "@") () (gz-sh pre "/dev/null")) (def gz-stdin (gz-in in)) (Sys chdir "/tmp/x-cu-gz/w") (sys-dup2 1 9) (sys-dup2 2 8) (def st (let ((oo (file-open-write (gz-f "o"))) (ee (file-open-write (gz-f "e")))) (do (sys-dup2 oo 1) (sys-dup2 ee 2) (def rs (cu-run argv gz-stdin)) (sys-dup2 9 1) (sys-dup2 8 2) (file-close oo) (file-close ee) rs))) (Sys chdir gz-home) (display (string-concat (list (gz-shown mode) "stderr:\n" (file-read-all (gz-f "e")) "status " (%cu-int->str st) "\n" (if (string=? post "@") "" (do (gz-sh post (gz-f "p")) (string-append "after:\n" (file-read-all (gz-f "p"))))))))))) (display "made"))
```
---
    made

## gzip

### standard input to standard output: busybox's header, mtime 0 and OS 3, then the deflate, CRC and length

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "hello" "@" "@" "x" (list "gzip")) (gz-case #t "three" "@" "@" "x" (list "gzip" "-9")))
```
---
```output
1f8b0800000000000003cb48cdc9c9e7020020303a3606000000
stderr:
status 0
1f8b0800000000000003cbcf4be52a29cfe72ac9284a4de50200b6d5e6250e00
0000
stderr:
status 0
```

### a file is replaced by FILE.gz, its mode kept; -k keeps it; -c writes to standard output and keeps it

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "rm hello.gz; chmod 640 hello" "ls -l hello* | awk '{print substr($1, 1, 10), $NF}'; od -An -v -tx1 hello.gz | tr -d ' \\n'; echo" "-" (list "gzip" "hello")) (gz-case #t "-" "rm hello.gz" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gzip" "-k" "hello")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls hello*" "x" (list "gzip" "-c" "hello" "three")))
```
---
```output

```

### FILE.gz already there is refused unless -f; a missing file is said and the rest are done

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" ": > hello.gz" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gzip" "hello")) (gz-case #t "-" ": > hello.gz" "ls hello*; od -An -v -tx1 hello.gz | tr -d ' \\n' | head -c 32; echo" "-" (list "gzip" "-f" "hello")) (gz-case #t "-" "rm three.gz" "ls three*" "-" (list "gzip" "nope" "three")))
```


### 200 KB, more than one piece in and out: gzip's output is the system gzip's to read, and back

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "awk 'BEGIN { for (i = 0; i < 20000; i++) printf \"%d %x %o line\\n\", i, i * 7919, i * 31 }' > big; wc -c < big" "gzip -dc big.gz | cmp - big && echo same; ls big*" "-" (list "gzip" "-k" "big")) (gz-case #t "-" "awk 'BEGIN { for (i = 0; i < 20000; i++) printf \"%d %x %o line\\n\", i, i * 7919, i * 31 }' > big; wc -c < big; gzip -c big > sys.gz" "cmp sys big && echo same; ls big sys*" "-" (list "gunzip" "-k" "sys.gz")))
```
---
```output
stderr:
status 0
after:
same
big
big.gz
stderr:
status 0
after:
same
big
sys
sys.gz
```

## decompressing

### gunzip: FILE.gz becomes FILE; .tgz becomes .tar; another suffix is ignored, and said

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "rm hello" "ls hello*; cat hello" "-" (list "gunzip" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls three*" "-" (list "gunzip" "three.tgz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "hello")))
```
---
```output
stderr:
status 0
after:
hello
hello
stderr:
status 0
after:
three
three.gz
three.tar
stderr:
gunzip: hello: unknown suffix - ignored
status 1
```

### the header's extra field, name, comment and CRC are passed over; a nonzero mtime is put on the file

```cu
(gz-case #t "-" "rm hello" "cat flags; ls -l flags | awk '{print $6, $7, $8}'" "-" (list "gunzip" "flags.gz"))
```
---
```output
stderr:
status 0
after:
hello
Jan 2 2020
```

### -c, -k, -t, -f; gzip -d is gunzip; zcat writes every file to standard output

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "hello.gz" "three.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "rm hello" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gunzip" "-k" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gunzip" "-t" "hello.gz" "three.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gunzip" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "cat hello" "-" (list "gunzip" "-f" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "rm hello" "ls hello*" "-" (list "gzip" "-d" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls hello* three*" "-" (list "zcat" "hello.gz" "three.gz")) (gz-case #t "two.gz" "@" "@" "-" (list "zcat")))
```

### what is not gzip data, or is broken: each said, its output removed, the status 1

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "rm -f plain" "ls plain*" "-" (list "gunzip" "plain.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "ls badcrc*" "-" (list "gunzip" "badcrc.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "badlen.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "short.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "header.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "badblock.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "empty.gz" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "zcat" "three" "hello.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "gunzip" "-c" "nope.gz" "hello.gz")))
```

## tar's z

### c with z writes the archive through gzip, busybox's header first; t and x with z read it back; a with a name ending gz is z

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "@" "od -An -v -tx1 x.tar.gz | tr -d ' \\n' | head -c 20; echo; gzip -dc x.tar.gz | tar tf -" "-" (list "tar" "czf" "x.tar.gz" "hello" "three")) (gz-case #f "-" "@" "@" "-" (list "tar" "tzf" "x.tar.gz")) (gz-case #f "-" "rm hello three" "cat hello three" "-" (list "tar" "xzvf" "x.tar.gz")) (gz-case #t "-" "@" "gzip -dc y.tgz | tar tf -" "-" (list "tar" "caf" "y.tgz" "hello")))
```
---
```output
stderr:
status 0
after:
1f8b0800000000000003
hello
three
hello|
three|
stderr:
status 0
hello|
three|
stderr:
status 0
after:
hello
one
two
three
stderr:
status 0
after:
hello
```

```cu
(do (gz-case #t "-" "tar cf p.tar hello" "@" "-" (list "tar" "tzf" "p.tar")) (gz-case #t "-" "tar cf p.tar hello three; gzip p.tar; head -c 30 p.tar.gz > cut.tar.gz" "@" "-" (list "tar" "tzf" "cut.tar.gz")))
```
